galaxy_setting.name: LeereEnabled
galaxy_setting.description:
Enables The Leere. A group of powerful entities whose only goal is to cause chaos.
Incredibly durable, the Leere's true power comes from their corruption aura, converting any and all deaths on its planet into Hostile to All zombies. In addition, it can endlessly revive its zombie swarm as they die, leading to a neverending black hole of 死亡. Attempting to engage it when it has its swarm surrounding it is not recommended for those who don't want 'part of a zombie horde' on their resume.

galaxy_setting.name: LeereRivalry
galaxy_setting.description:
REQUIRES the Leere to be enabled.
Allows two more Leere subfactions to spawn into the galaxy allied to both Player Zombies and AI Zombies respectively.
They act much like the regular Leere, with a few key differences: These Leere subfactions will never spawn more Leere if they already match or outnumber the Hostile to All Leere. They will ALWAYS spawn on a 人类/AI Homeworld. The Zombification Aura is active for the most influencial Zombie faction near that planet. (The Zombie Infestation Map Mode may help.)
